secretShape.label: Linear personal API key
secretShape.description: Create a personal API key in Linear. Do not enter your Linear account password. Grant read access and limit the key to only the teams you want Gezel to sync.

setupInstructions.title: Create a Linear personal API key
setupInstructions.description: Gezel uses this key only to read issues through Linear's API. Your normal Linear password does not belong here.
steps: In Linear, open Settings, then Account, then Security & Access.
Under Personal API keys, create a new key named Gezel.
Grant read permissions and restrict team access to only the teams you want synced.
Copy the generated key and paste it into the Linear personal API key field.
